description: Scheduling — advisory hook steering Claude toward the parse/generate scripts for managed HTML artifacts (project-context.html). Always advisory; never blocks.

hooks.command: python -c "import os,re,runpy;r=os.environ['CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT'];m=re.match(r'^/([a-zA-Z])/(.*)',r) if os.name=='nt' else None;r=(m.group(1).upper()+':/'+m.group(2)) if m else r;runpy.run_path(r+'/hooks/check_html_discipline.py',run_name='__main__')"
